metadata.title: Kegry. Find Your Bar Buddy!
metadata.description: Kegry helps you find bar buddies. No dating, no endless texting - just spontaneous real-life meetups at the bar. The best stories start off-screen!
metadata.keywords: bar buddy, drinking buddy, meet people IRL, real life social, bar meetups, offline friends, unicorn, kegry, loyalty programs, off-screen stories

cheers.title: Find Your Bar Buddy Right Now!
cheers.description: Up for a drink and good company? No dating. No endless chats. Check a profile, send an invite, arrange a meetup, and there you go, you're at the bar! Talk about life, laugh, vent and keep your head up. If any goblins appear, maybe it's time to slow down a bit 🥴
cheers.loyaltyPrograms: And one more thing: don't forget about our <link>loyalty programs</link>.

pollsNews.pollDescription: We value every member of our community! If you have ideas or want to help us make things even better, please vote for the feature you'd most like to see next.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.note: Hey adventurer! Just a heads-up: invites expire, you can have only one chat at a time, and there is a limited number of messages per chat, so choose wisely. Invite buddies only if you're really ready for a bar adventure and hurry before the goblins drink all the beer!

loyalty.title: Loyalty Programs
loyalty.description:
Our partner venues can offer loyalty programs with discounts through our service. The more often you visit and check in at venues, the more you save! 😊
You can always check the currently available discounts in your profile.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.description: You might be wondering the same thing we are: are these goblins the same or different? Honestly, we're not sure yet... We still haven't figured out how to tell them apart. If you happen to know how to, or if you have any questions or suggestions about the service, we'd be happy to hear from you via email at <email>contacts@kegry.com</email> or through our <chat>chat</chat>.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: To provide you with the best experience, we need access to your location and notifications.
permissions.locationDesc: Absolutely necessary to discover people and venues around. Without it, the feed won't work.
permissions.locationDescNotOnboarded: Simplifies check-in via QR code. If a venue doesn't support PIN-code check-in, location access is required to complete your check-in.
permissions.notificationsDesc: The app will work without notifications enabled, but you won't receive invitations or new message notifications. The user experience of some features will also be degraded.

notifications.title: To enable Notifications:
notifications.desc: Currently, browser notifications on iOS are only available when the website is installed as an app. To do this:
notifications.step1: Tap the Share icon in Safari.

location.title: To enable Location:
location.step1: Open Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services
location.step4: Choose "While Using the App" and turn on "Precise Location"
location.step5: Tap Site Settings in the Safari navigation bar.
location.step7: Scroll to the bottom to Website Settings for kegry.rs.

androidDesktop.title: Android and Desktop
androidDesktop.step1: Tap the settings icon in your browser’s address bar
androidDesktop.step5: If location is still disabled after this, check your device's <link>system settings</link> to ensure that location access is enabled for your browser.
